title: 第15章 败家儿子
slug: 似锦全本免费-似锦最新章节列表
content_zh:
姜湛被拍了一个趔趄，却扬起灿烂笑脸：“走了，走了，今日大家辛苦，小爷出钱请你们喝酒！”
跟来的仆从齐声叫好。
姜安诚斜睨着姜湛，压低声音问：“你哪来的钱？”
混小子给似儿买灌汤包还是从他这里讨的钱呢。
姜湛笑嘻嘻道：“还是老规矩，先从父亲这里赊着呗。”
“滚你的老规矩！”姜安诚气得踹了姜湛屁股一脚。
顺利退亲，父子二人皆心情愉快，姜湛果然从姜安诚这里讨到了银子，带着这次出力的几个仆从去小酒馆喝酒。
“今天随便喝，只要跟着本公子混，以后少不了你们的酒喝！”姜湛举起酒杯，豪气干云道。
“多谢二公子，以后小的们就跟您混了！”仆从们纷纷举杯。
主仆几人喝得痛快，却听隔壁有声音传来。
“听说了没，东平伯府与安国公府真的退亲了！”
“能没听说么，东平伯把聘礼往安国公府大门前一摆，多少人瞧见啊。啧啧，没想到东平伯府倒是有志气的。”
“呵呵，我却觉得东平伯太傻了。现在逞一时痛快退了亲，以后他们府上那位四姑娘上哪找比安国公府更好的婆家去？”
“主要是安国公府的三公子太不像话了。”
“不像话？”那人嗤笑一声，“男人嘛，流连青楼的大把，妻妾成群的大把，一时迷恋个女子算什么？要是照东平伯这么眼里容不得沙子，我看姜四姑娘这辈子注定要当老姑娘喽。”
姜湛一听就来了火气，把酒杯往地上一掷，腾腾跑了过去，拽着一名男子的衣领吼道：“再胡说八道，小爷撕了你的嘴！”
那人被这突如其来的变故惊呆了，瞪大眼睛瞧了姜湛好一会儿，才哆嗦着道：“你，你是谁呀？”
姜湛一怔。
奇怪，声音好像不对。
与那男子相对而坐的另一名男子已经悄悄起身准备开溜了。

姜湛恍然大悟：“站住，原来嚼舌的是你！”
他抄起酒桌上一个盘子砸过去。
盘子里的汤汁泼了那人一后背。
那人也恼了，扭头质问道：“你是什么人？平白无故耍什么酒疯？”
“睁大你的狗眼看清楚了，小爷就是东平伯府的二公子！你敢胡乱议论我妹妹，小爷今天要把你打成猪头！”
那人一脚已经跨到了门外，淋了一身的菜汤很是恼火，估摸着眼前这唇红齿白的少年跑不过他，反唇相讥道：“哟，原来是要当一辈子老姑娘的姜四姑娘的哥哥啊？真是幸会啊。”
“混蛋，你说谁嫁不出去呢？没了安国公府，我妹妹会嫁得更好！”姜湛一双精致好看的眸子中喷出火来。
“快别做梦了，要说安国公府的三公子会娶到门第更好的姑娘倒是真的，至于姜四姑娘……我看你还是赶紧回去安慰妹子吧。”
姜湛再也听不下去，箭步冲过去把那人踹翻在地，抡起拳头如雨点般落下去。
“出人命啦，出人命啦——”被压在下边的人杀猪般惨叫起来。
酒馆伙计察觉不对，赶忙跑到街上找来巡逻的官差，等官差赶到时，那人已经被姜湛揍得亲娘都认不出来了。
最终姜安诚赔了那人二十两银子的医药费，又给了差爷十两银子的辛苦费，才把败家儿子赎回来。
回到府中，姜安诚飞起一脚就把姜湛踹倒了：“小畜生，没有一日让老子省心！”
姜湛揉着屁股很是委屈：“父亲，这事不怪儿子，那混账嘴巴不干净，胡乱议论妹妹呢。”
“议论你妹妹？”
“是啊！”姜湛赶忙把事情来龙去脉说了一遍，气道，“要是说我也就罢了，可那人竟把妹妹挂在嘴边上，儿子听了险些气炸了肺，揍他一顿已经便宜他了！”
姜安诚听了不由沉默。
对退亲他虽然没有丝毫后悔，可女儿将来的归属无异于一块重石压在了他心头。
姜湛爬了起来，顺势道：“难道父亲认为儿子听到别人非议妹妹，不该出头？”
姜安诚一脚再次把姜湛踹趴下，恨铁不成钢道：“老子不是不让你出头，而是气你蠢！官差来之前不会跑啊？”

这败家子啊，三十两银子就这么飞了！
姜湛眨眨眼。
咦，父亲提醒得有道理！
“父亲放心，以后儿子晓得了，打了人立马就跑！”
“还有下次？我打死你这不省心的小畜生！”
姜湛拔腿就跑：“您歇会儿吧，踹得脚怪疼的。儿子去看看妹妹。”

content_en:
Jiang Zhan staggered when he was photographed, but he raised a bright smile: "Let's go, let's go, everyone has worked hard today, I will pay for you to drink!"
The servants who followed cheered in unison.
Jiang Ancheng glanced sideways at Jiang Zhan and asked in a low voice, "Where did you get the money?"
Should the bastard buy soup dumplings for Si'er or ask for money from him.
Jiang Zhan said with a smile: "It's still the old rule, let's get it on credit from my father first."
"Get out of your old ways!" Jiang Ancheng was so angry that he kicked Jiang Zhan's butt.
After successfully breaking off the engagement, both father and son were in a happy mood. As expected, Jiang Zhan got money from Jiang Ancheng and went to the tavern to drink with a few servants who had contributed this time.
"Drink whatever you want today. As long as you hang out with me, I will inevitably drink from you in the future!" Jiang Zhan raised his glass and said boldly.
"Thank you, Second Young Master. From now on, the younger ones will join you!" The servants raised their glasses.
The master and the servants were drinking happily, but they heard a sound coming from next door.
"Have you heard that Duke Dongping's Mansion and Duke An Guo's Mansion have really called off their engagement?"
"How could you not have heard that Uncle Dongping placed the betrothal gift in front of the gate of Duke Anguo's Mansion, and how many people saw it? Tsk, tsk, I didn't expect that Uncle Dongping's Mansion was very ambitious."
"Haha, I think Uncle Dong Ping is too stupid. Now that he has broken off the engagement for a while, where can the fourth girl in their family find a better in-law than Duke Anguo's family?"
"The main reason is that the Third Young Master of Anguo Duke's Mansion is so outrageous."
"That's outrageous?" The man sneered, "Men, there are so many who hang out in brothels, and so many have wives and concubines, what does it mean to be obsessed with a girl for a while? If Uncle Zhaodong Ping is so intolerant, I think Miss Jiang Si is destined to be an old girl in her life."
When Jiang Zhan heard this, he became angry. He threw the wine glass on the ground, Teng Teng ran over, grabbed a man by the collar and shouted: "If you talk nonsense again, I will tear your mouth off!"
The man was stunned by this sudden turn of events. He stared at Jiang Zhan with wide eyes for a while, then trembled and said, "Who are you?"
Jiang Zhan was startled.
Weird, the sound seems wrong.
Another man sitting opposite the man had quietly stood up and was about to leave.
Jiang Zhan suddenly realized: "Stop, it turns out you are the one talking nonsense!"
He picked up a plate from the wine table and threw it at it.
The soup on the plate splashed on the man's back.
The man was also annoyed, turned around and asked: "Who are you? Why are you so drunk for no reason?"
"Open your dog eyes and see clearly, I am the second son of Dongping uncle's house! If you dare to talk nonsense about my sister, I will beat you into a pig's head today!"
The man had already stepped outside the door. He was very annoyed when he was drenched in vegetable soup. He estimated that the young man with red lips and white teeth in front of him could not run away from him, so he retorted: "Oh, it turns out he is the brother of Miss Jiang Si who wants to be an old girl all her life? What a pleasure to meet you."
"Asshole, who do you think can't get married? Without Anguo Gongfu, my sister will marry better!" Jiang Zhan's exquisite and beautiful eyes burst out with fire.
"Stop dreaming. It's true to say that the third son of Duke An Guo will marry a girl with a better family background. As for the fourth girl Jiang... I think you should go back and comfort the girl quickly."
Jiang Zhan couldn't listen any longer, so he rushed over and kicked the man to the ground, and raised his fists and rained them down.
"It's a life-threatening situation, it's a life-threatening situation -" the person underneath screamed like a pig.
The tavern clerk noticed something was wrong and hurriedly ran to the street to find the patrol officer. When the officer arrived, the man had been beaten by Jiang Zhan to the point where his mother could not recognize him.
In the end, Jiang Ancheng paid the man 20 taels of silver for his medical expenses and paid Master Chai 10 taels of silver for his hard work before he redeemed his prodigal son.
Back in the mansion, Jiang Ancheng kicked Jiang Zhan down with a flying kick: "You little beast, you never let me worry about this!"
Jiang Zhan rubbed his butt and felt aggrieved: "Father, it's not my son's fault for this. That bastard has such a bad mouth."You're so clean, you're talking nonsense about your sister. "
"Talk about your sister? "
"yes! "Jiang Zhan hurriedly told the whole story, and said angrily, "If it was me, that would be fine, but that man actually talked about his sister. His son almost exploded with anger after hearing this. Beating him up was already an advantage for him! "
Jiang Ancheng couldn't help but remain silent after hearing this.
Although he had no regrets about breaking off the engagement, his daughter's future fate was like a heavy stone weighing on his heart.
Jiang Zhan got up and said, "Does the father think that his son shouldn't come forward when he hears others criticizing his sister? "
Jiang Ancheng kicked Jiang Zhan to the ground again and said, "I am not refusing to let you get ahead, but I am angry that you are stupid! You won’t run away before the official comes? "
This prodigal son, thirty taels of silver just flew away!
Jiang Zhan blinked.
Hey, my father’s reminder makes sense!
"Father, don't worry. If your son knows about it in the future, he will run away immediately after hitting someone! "
"And next time? I'll beat you to death, you careless little beast! "
Jiang Zhan ran away: "Please rest for a while, your feet hurt from kicking. The son went to see his sister. "
